research.title: Fresnel lens
research.note: Supplies the About page fact "A lens that makes a beam": The Better lens upgrade makes the beam carry one step further.

research.title: Lighthouse
research.note: The About page facts on winding the clockwork and on what the lamp burned: the clockwork runs down unless you wind it, and oil is the thing you can never have enough of.

research.title: Fog signal
research.note: Supplies the About page fact "Bells for the fog": The Fog bell upgrade takes some of the fog's cost off your beam.

other.title: Pyodide
other.note: Runs the game's Python rules in the browser through WebAssembly (version 0.26.4, loaded from a CDN), so the game needs no server of its own and no build step.
